messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T at 10¢: stacks ~57,500 sats a month, about $48, power runs $47 a month, block odds roughly 0.22% a year.
Looked up for Sarah: Say verbatim: "At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it." Then the block shot and learning.

At under twelve cents you've got some of the cheapest power for home mining, and the Magic Miner 40T is seven ninety-nine, our best value per terahash. It takes a shot at a full three-point-one-two-five Bitcoin block about every ten minutes and stacks sats to your own wallet in the meantime.

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy the 40T for a shot at a full 3.125 Bitcoin block every ten minutes, around the clock, while it stacks sats straight to their own wallet. (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
